finding.summary: The httpx.Client created in make_chat_model is never closed, leaking connection pools and file descriptors. ChatOpenAI does not take ownership of the passed http_client; the caller must close it.
finding.fix: Make ReviewSession a context manager that closes the client, or store the client on the session and add a close() method. Alternatively, use a context manager in make_chat_model and ensure the caller closes it.

label: false_positive
label_reason: Raised in review and merged with the file unchanged.
